test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the greatest number which leaves the same remainder in each case, when divides 265, 580 and 825?
solution:
**Concept Used:**

The greatest number that would leave the same remainder in each case would be the HCF of the difference of the numbers.

**Calculation:**

Difference of the numbers

⇒ 580 - 265 = 315

⇒ 825 - 580 = 245

⇒ 825 - 265&n
